content: Fostemsavir can increase the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of atorvastatin. This interaction occurs due to the inhibition of OATP1B1/3 and BCRP transporters by fostemsavir. It is recommended to avoid coadministration if possible or adjust the dose of atorvastatin accordingly.
